name: Danaher Leg Lock System
summary: Leglocks: Enter The System by John Danaher covers leg-entanglement control, heel hooks, toe holds and entries from standing and the ground.
description: John Danaher’s eight-volume leg-lock course, from inside position and knee-line control to submission mechanics and entries.
overview:
John Danaher develops leg attacks around gaining inside position, controlling the knee line and moving between ashi configurations. The course covers inside and outside heel hooks, toe holds and the problems created by an opponent’s rotation or leg positioning.

Its eight volumes combine control and finishing material with entries from standing exchanges and guard. That breadth suits a grappler building a connected leg-attack game beyond a single ankle-lock finish.

guide.display_title: John Danaher: Leglocks — Enter The System

fits: You want leg-entanglement control, recovery and entries alongside heel-hook finishing mechanics.

includes: Gripping, inside position, knee-line recovery and single-leg, double-leg and cross-ashi configurations.
Rotational resistance, toe holds, leg switches and entries from standing, half guard and other ground positions.
limits: Heel hooks and rotational control occupy substantial parts of the course; it is broader than an ankle-lock-only instructional.
